description: What the running engine is: its version and, for a source checkout, where it is and which commit it is at.

commit.description: The full 40-character Git commit the installation folder is at; null when there is no installation folder, the folder is not itself a Git checkout (a folder inside another repository is not one), or Git is not installed.
commit.title: Commit

engine_version.description: The installed version of the engine distribution.
engine_version.title: Engine Version

installation_folder.description: The folder of the source checkout the engine runs from, as the platform writes a path; null when the engine was installed as a package.
installation_folder.title: Installation Folder

uncommitted_changes.description: True when the checkout has changes to tracked files or untracked files that Git does not ignore, false when it has none; null whenever the commit is null or Git could not report the status.
uncommitted_changes.title: Uncommitted Changes

title: AboutDocument
